fact_text: Flooding along Punjab's river embankments is expected to lead to government-led reconstruction, which the analyst expects to lift demand for cement and steel.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📅 Midday Flash 29 August 2025 | DGKC | PIBTL | Refineries' (YouTube, 2025-08-29)

fact_text: Pakistan's cement consumption was lower in 2023 to 2025 than it was in 2020-21, according to the analyst.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📅 Midday Flash 29 August 2025 | DGKC | PIBTL | Refineries' (YouTube, 2025-08-29)

fact_text: DG Khan Cement's FY25 sales rose to about PKR 72 billion from PKR 66 billion.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📅 Midday Flash 29 August 2025 | DGKC | PIBTL | Refineries' (YouTube, 2025-08-29)

fact_text: DG Khan Cement repaid about PKR 9 billion of long-term loan principal in FY25, cutting principal debt from about PKR 16 billion to PKR 10 billion, and repaid about PKR 3 billion of short-term debt.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📅 Midday Flash 29 August 2025 | DGKC | PIBTL | Refineries' (YouTube, 2025-08-29)

fact_text: DG Khan Cement's gross margin closed FY25 at about 25%, up from about 15%.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📅 Midday Flash 29 August 2025 | DGKC | PIBTL | Refineries' (YouTube, 2025-08-29)

fact_text: DG Khan Cement's short-term investments rose to about PKR 24 billion, which the analyst treats as cash-equivalent holdings.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📅 Midday Flash 29 August 2025 | DGKC | PIBTL | Refineries' (YouTube, 2025-08-29)

fact_text: DG Khan Cement announced a dividend of PKR 2 per share with its FY25 results.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📅 Midday Flash 29 August 2025 | DGKC | PIBTL | Refineries' (YouTube, 2025-08-29)

fact_text: Cement prices in Punjab and the northern zone remain firm, and DG Khan Cement earned good prices on its clinker exports, which supported its results.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📅 Midday Flash 29 August 2025 | DGKC | PIBTL | Refineries' (YouTube, 2025-08-29)

fact_text: The analyst compares cement makers on enterprise value per ton of capacity, citing a reference level of about USD 50 per ton.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📅 Midday Flash 29 August 2025 | DGKC | PIBTL | Refineries' (YouTube, 2025-08-29)

fact_text: Attock Refinery is a mid-country refinery that receives its crude oil from its parent company, Pakistan Oil Fields.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📅 Midday Flash 29 August 2025 | DGKC | PIBTL | Refineries' (YouTube, 2025-08-29)

fact_text: The analyst values Attock Refinery's cash on the balance sheet at roughly PKR 600 per share on a cash basis.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📅 Midday Flash 29 August 2025 | DGKC | PIBTL | Refineries' (YouTube, 2025-08-29)

fact_text: The analyst expects first-quarter results of the coastal refineries, Pakistan Refinery (PRL) and National Refinery (NRL), to improve, while noting that this still has to be watched.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📅 Midday Flash 29 August 2025 | DGKC | PIBTL | Refineries' (YouTube, 2025-08-29)

fact_text: The analyst sees listed Punjab steel makers benefiting from reconstruction demand for rebar, beams and girders, and from any ML-1 railway work.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📅 Midday Flash 29 August 2025 | DGKC | PIBTL | Refineries' (YouTube, 2025-08-29)

fact_text: Ittefaq Steel carries little debt on its balance sheet and is a smaller producer than Mughal Steel.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📅 Midday Flash 29 August 2025 | DGKC | PIBTL | Refineries' (YouTube, 2025-08-29)

fact_text: According to newspaper reports the analyst cites, the ML-1 railway project, earlier planned with China, is to be financed by the Asian Development Bank.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📅 Midday Flash 29 August 2025 | DGKC | PIBTL | Refineries' (YouTube, 2025-08-29)

fact_text: The analyst says a Japanese bank is showing keen interest in financing Pakistan's reconstruction work.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📅 Midday Flash 29 August 2025 | DGKC | PIBTL | Refineries' (YouTube, 2025-08-29)

fact_text: PIBTL handles coal through its conveyor-belt terminal; the analyst says the coal imports come from Richards Bay, so its volumes track the number of ships calling.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📅 Midday Flash 29 August 2025 | DGKC | PIBTL | Refineries' (YouTube, 2025-08-29)

fact_text: The analyst says PIBTL's books carry fewer foreign loans, so exchange-rate losses are smaller and its results can stay strong if vessel numbers hold up.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '📅 Midday Flash 29 August 2025 | DGKC | PIBTL | Refineries' (YouTube, 2025-08-29)
